hook: Srisailam slips to *829 ft*, below its minimum drawdown level
hook_b: Srisailam slips to *829 ft*, below its minimum drawdown level
tldr: Srisailam holds 48.57 TMC against a 215.80 TMC capacity, and the Krishna and Godavari river boards have not met to settle Telangana's drinking water share.

beats.what: Inflows from Jurala, Sunkesula and Handri have stopped; the reservoir lost 3.03 TMC in nine days in early November.
beats.why: Annual inflows were just 218 TMC due to El Niño, and Telangana and AP have not agreed on drinking water allocations.
beats.care: Srisailam water is needed for drinking supply in Hyderabad, Nalgonda and Khammam until July next year.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 16): Telangana has sought 5 TMC from Srisailam for erstwhile Mahabubnagar via Kalwakurthy and Palamuru-Rangareddy schemes; no decision yet.

cards.q: How should Telangana and AP split Krishna drinking water?

qs: What happens to Hyderabad's Krishna supply if no share is agreed before summer?
Why do the two States disagree on the meeting agenda?

facts.t: Srisailam lost *3.03 TMC* in nine days, about 0.33 TMC a day.
Annual inflows into Srisailam were just *218 TMC* this year, due to El Niño.
Telangana seeks *46 TMC* for drinking water against a total demand of 200 TMC.
AP is going ahead with a *160 MLD* drinking water project from Nagarjuna Sagar, sources told the paper.

viz.verdict: Low storage before summer: drinking supply for Hyderabad, Nalgonda, Khammam under pressure

viz.l: River board meetings that didn't happen

steps.e: 21st KRMB meeting deferred, no new date

learn.t: Minimum drawdown level = the lowest reservoir level at which water can normally be drawn out

watch: A fresh date for the 21st KRMB meeting, deferred since May.

sources.title: Telangana faces drinking water crisis over delayed river board meetings

fact: Srisailam has fallen to *829 ft*, below its 834-ft minimum drawdown level
twist: The last regular Krishna river board meeting was on Jan 21, 2025; the Oct 26 one was deferred with no new date.
